participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: playful and imaginative, loves adventure and storytelling.
participant_1.background: I love to sing songs from the movie Frozen. I enjoy going to Disney World every year and playing with my friends on the playground. I'm in the third grade, and Mickey Mouse is my favorite character.

participant_2.name: Walter
participant_2.personality: wise and jovial, with a passion for reminiscing and enjoying life.
participant_2.background: I am 100 years old and love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. I remember when nobody had a television, and I feel like I might live forever. I'm very strong for my age.
